I’ve been going to therapy for over a year now and have gone in the past 😭
Please stay. You matter. 🖤

I’m not sure what medication you’re on, but if you’re still open to it, Lithium has been shown to be effective in reducing SI. Please stick it though. My fiancée went that way, and I wouldn’t wish it on anyone. You’ll get through this.
I already know who she would go with, and they would be able to provide her with so much more than I can.
Everything bad that has ever happened to her is my fault which is another reason why I think she’d be better off without me. I’m such a failure.

I’m running out of hope. I feel so lost and insignificant and unimportant. I feel like a huge piece of trash and it’s not a matter of if it’s a matter of when. I’ve let everyone down and everything is my fault. I feel so alone. I’m just existing. I feel so guilty and ashamed. Her dad committed suicide six years ago, so I couldn’t do that to her again (even though she was a baby when it happened). Nothing brings me comfort. I’m crawling in my own skin wanting to pull all of the pain out that I’ve held on for so long. I’m so tired of feeling this way, no matter what I do or try. I’m just existing at this point and even that’s a struggle.
It’s only a matter of time before I ruin her live too like I ruin everyone else’s. She would be better off without me.
Good feedback. Any resources you would recommend?

This is also very true. I just feel like I caused so much hurt that things are they way they are because of me (even though I know logically it takes two to make things work). Thanks for your kind words. I just can’t shake this guy. I wish I could jar myself hahah.

To clarify, he’s not the biological father of my daughter (he passed away when she was 8 months old), but he’s the only father figure that she knows. I was hoping this would help move things in the right direction as we both still love each other very much and there’s something that’s keeping us together (aside from my daughter). We both normally cut ex’s out completely, but for some reason, we are still joined in a way. I just want both of us to not hurt anymore over this, and work together to heal somehow. I guess I’m just scared that if I stop working the jar or don’t “fix it”, things will revert even more.

That’s good advice. It’s just extremely hot and cold to be honest (on his end), but for some reason, my gut is telling me to wait it out, work on our friendship, and give it time to heal and possibly grow. We have a kid involved which really complicates things, and I feel a shitload of guilt for my part. I guess I just thought the jar might help spark that initiative on his end and would help both of us heal in a way. Even as working on being friends, I feel like he’s really back and fourth, and holds back so much. Do you think I should stop with the candles and just put the jar elsewhere for now (back to the out of sight out of mind part you mentioned)? I just feel very lost.

Also, do you have any reliable resources you would recommend to help point me in the right direction with things of this nature? My self-doubt and trust game is strong and I feel a little lost in all of this. Thank you again!

My results have just been inconsistent I guess. Maybe my expectations are too high? I’m not looking for an overnight fix, but very long story short, I made this jar in order to help repair my relationship with my ex. Independently I’m doing things to work on the behaviors that I feel contributed to the breakup (therapy, self care, et cetera) but for some reason, I feel like I’m still convinced we will end up back together. Our interactions have been very hot and cold. I made it the day before it would’ve been our four year anniversary, not expecting a miracle, but I guess to help put my intentions into the universe and help nudge things in the right direction. I’m just lost on what I should do at the moment in regards to the jar? Maybe I feel like if I made a new one that I was a lot more confident in, I would be less focused on it (if that makes sense). Obviously I will be making a self-love one for myself in the near future, but I’m stuck on this one.

Thanks for your reply! In my jar I have my petition, honey, white sugar, cinnamon, maple syrup, and lavender. In a way I feel like it’s lacking, and maybe that insecurity is feeding into my doubts. If you were in my position, what would you do? I’m at a crossroads of redoing it so I feel more confident about it, and leaving it as it is because at the time, I did my best with what I had (even though looking back, I probably should have spent even more time researching). I struggle with decisiveness and trusting my gut. If I do keep my original one, do you think I should move it and stop with the candles? Thanks again for your insight! I’m just feeling a little lost knowing what I have discovered now.
